stem:
An excess of aqueous ammonia is added to a solution containing the complex ion $[\text{Co}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$.

$$[\text{Co}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+} + 6\text{NH}_3 \rightleftharpoons [\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+} + 6\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Complete the sentence to describe the colour change that will be seen during this reaction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Write an expression for the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The numerical value of $K_{\text{stab}}$ of $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$ is $7.7 \times 10^4$.

What deduction about the properties of $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$ and $[\text{Co}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ can be made from this $K_{\text{stab}}$ value?

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem:
Oxygen can oxidise $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$ to $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{3+}$ under standard conditions in alkaline solutions.

$$[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{3+} + \text{e}^- \rightleftharpoons [\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+} \quad E^{\ominus} = +0.10\text{ V}$$

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Use this information and the Data Booklet to calculate the $E^{\ominus}_{\text{cell}}$ value for this oxidation of $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Write an ionic equation for this oxidation of $[\text{Co}(\text{NH}_3)_6]^{2+}$.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Predict, by selecting suitable data from the Data Booklet, whether oxygen can oxidise $\text{Co}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ in acidic solution, in the absence of ammonia. Explain your answer.
